findings.title: User-charts cost notice path is untested
findings.problem: The 'user-charts' route returns no metadata and UsersView.test.tsx gives chartCostState and tableCostState identical values, so fetchUsersCharts dropping withCostMetadata or UsersView swapping the two states would not fail any test.
findings.impact: Regression could leave the Cost Share by User donut with a wrong or missing partial-cost warning while tests stay green.
findings.recommendation: Route 'user-charts' to partial metadata and 'users' to full metadata and assert exactly one cost-incomplete-notice in the Cost Share by User widget and none in the All Users table, then the reverse.
findings.resolution: Fixed in 3d9770efe: the integration test routes user-charts and users to different metadata and asserts each notice comes from its own answer, in both directions.

findings.title: Unnamed incomplete models get no per-row mark
findings.problem: cost_incomplete true with empty unpriced_models yields ['some models'], so isModelUnpriced matches nothing and CostView shows $0 model bars unmarked while the notice says some models have no price.
findings.impact: Reachability unconfirmed (depends on whether the backend ever flags without naming models); if it does, unpriced models read as real $0.
findings.recommendation: When unpricedModels is the UNNAMED_MODELS placeholder, treat every $0-cost model row as unknown in isModelUnpriced.
findings.resolution: Declined. The backend derives cost_incomplete as bool(unpriced) (cli_analytics.py:442, :863, funding_buckets.py:64), so a flagged answer always names its models and the unnamed placeholder is unreachable; per-row unknown cost is deliberately not inferred from selection flags (a Personal-paid-only user has a real $0 company spend while another user sets the flags).

findings.title: An empty model name reads "no price for " in the notices
findings.problem: The backend keeps an empty model name as reported (unpriced_display_names: "an empty name stays empty"), so a flagged session with no model recorded gives a name list with an empty entry in the Cost by Model statement and in CostIncompleteNotice.
findings.impact: Wording only: the cost is still shown as unknown / understated and the notice is still present; the affected model is just not named. Not present in the synthetic verification data.
findings.recommendation: Render an empty name as a placeholder such as "unknown model" in the model list; follow-up, not blocking.
